subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Which remaining #87711 subproblem should be canonical for next work: reset binding durability/self-heal, Telegram no-text delivery diagnostics, progress heartbeat, or reset/warm-start UX?
rationale: The current evidence supports a real reset/session-state gap, but the issue also asks for new diagnostics and UX surfaces that should not be bundled into one automated repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Prioritize reset binding durability
options.body: Treat the durable session-store/transcript invariant as the canonical fix and split delivery diagnostics and UX requests into follow-up issues.

options.title: Split all subproblems first
options.body: Keep this as a tracking umbrella and require maintainers to open or designate separate canonical issues before any implementation starts.

options.title: Focus on Telegram visible recovery
options.body: Prioritize a user-visible Telegram fallback or progress heartbeat first, accepting that the lower-level phantom-binding invariant remains separate work.

recommendation.title: Prioritize reset binding durability
recommendation.body: Treat the durable session-store/transcript invariant as the canonical fix and split delivery diagnostics and UX requests into follow-up issues.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest remaining source-backed failure mode is in reset transcript lifecycle history, where Tak Hoffman authored the central reset-path commits.
